control: ops_prefill row-loop head RMSNorm/RoPE, original device scalar RMSNorm/RoPE helpers
complete_change: Distribute B x query-head or KV-head over slices and compute head RMSNorm plus RoPE once across all rows, preserving the original per-head F32 reduction/order and BF16 commit boundaries. Full K and V share their identical raw-key RMS denominator.
removed_work: Sixteen serial row passes; full RoPE additionally performs sixteen serial query-head passes per row; repeated norm-weight and RoPE preparation.
added_work: Direct head-slice input placement and batched RoPE gather/redistribution.
validation: Compile, then NPU compare all B16 Q/K/V values to original scalar helpers using distinct nonzero values, weights, positions and actual full partial-RoPE tables. Time complete candidate/control launches, no zero smoke as correctness evidence.
decision: Integrate only if numerical checks pass and measured head stage improves; root measures complete-model effect.
